caveats: Fixtures follow the BFF contract shape named in the task brief (persona_display_names, is_synthetic_or_stub, stub_reason, hidden_non_real_count, is_non_real, name_is_fallback_id, display_summary, execution_state, last_error, dead_letter_count, topic_summary). No recorded 2026-11-20 hosted JSON capture was present in this repository, so the fixtures are hand-cut to those field names, not copied byte-for-byte from hosted responses; real ids (strategy-persona-298e138c136c9840b0e4, strat-tw-official) are reused from existing fixtures.

Exact BFF query/meta names for hiding stubs are not documented in this repo: the strategies slice reuses the existing include_test_personas / hide_retired_personas / hidden_test_persona_strategy_count contract, research uses include_non_real, meetings use include_failed. If the BFF names differ, only strategies.ts, lists.ts (listResearchTasksEnvelope) and meetings.ts need renaming.
display_summary is accepted either as an object {symbol,dataset_ref,subject_ref} or a plain string; topic_summary is looked up as an i18n key and falls back to the raw text.

Screenshots were rendered from jsdom DOM of the real components with CSS compiled by the installed tailwindcss 3.4 (the project pins v4, which is not installed in this environment), so spacing/colors may differ slightly from the production build.
